reason: The gap fill survives, but not as drafted. It is text only, pre-score, and changes no existing row or pair. The poll at 06:03:58Z still shows #37 56563521 and #38 56563534 PENDING, so it can still be committed before any result. Its value is procedural: no undefined pair and no unlogged post-hoc choice. Score EV is ~1e-5. Three defects must be fixed before pasting. (1) W1 is anti-conservative in exactly the case it exists for. 'The floor, row 2 and C4 read the LATER of the two' contradicts its own 'first result it reads' wording. The twin is expected first (~06:15-07:40Z) and K2 later (~07:00-09:30Z). Under the draft, an OK sent after poll.log shows twin = 0.952 but before K2 scores would validly count for the floor. That is the post-hoc case PC6-01 names, and round5 report.json l.19 says the floor is post-hoc once the twin's score is visible. (2) W1 is also over-strict on event items. The C2(a) K2 resubmit, the row-1/C2(c) K1 and W7 react to an ERROR class that carries no score. PC6-01 allows OKs for these after the event, but W1 would call them 'late'. (3) W6 gives the K2 resubmit only +8.0 h. Its R5(a) mark is 9.5 h, the same as K2's under V7. W7 is not refuted, but a pre-OK is worth ~5e-6 and adds an 8th item to a 7-item OK message. Once W1 is corrected, W7 can simply be asked if the event happens (P ~0.01). Slot cost is ~0 because 27-28 Sep have 5 slots each. W2, W5 and W8 are correct but mostly restate the table, C3 and V1. W3 fits the §f +0.002 simpler-file rule and R7. W4 is fine. In row 5->4 the runtime risk moves to K1 (same 8.0 h gate), but K1 must still be R5-admissible, so the 9.5 h degrade is guarded by the rules.
fix: Paste as 'READ TABLE CLARIFICATION v4' only while poll.log has no COMPLETE/ERROR line for 56563521 or 56563534. Otherwise record it as post-hoc NOTES. Keep W2, W3, W4, W5 and W8 as drafted. Floor: the twin's result. Row-2 F2 = K2 and C4 K1: the earlier of K2 and twin. Row-4 K1: K2's result. Otherwise the [bracketed] strict text applies, and any later user choice is logged as a user decision after score. EVENT items may be OK'd after the event because they read an error class, not a score: the C2(a) K2 resubmit, the row-1/C2(c) K1 and W7.' Replace W6's K2 resubmit mark with +9.5 h (R5(a)), keeping K1 +9.5 h and K2'' +10.5 h. Change W7 to an event item: 'Twin Kaggle Error alone: ask the user then (one unchanged resubmit of exp58n v1); default F2 = exp52 by f2.' Do not add it to the pending-OK list. Add W1's one sentence to the OK message. Also add the precedence line from R6H-1: v4 > v3 > v2 > table > f2 > §f.
